title: 逆さまの秒針が刻む、砂の柩
author: 迷宮 アリス

en.title: The Sand Coffin Ticked by an Inverted Second Hand
en.premise: Following a 'secret map' that exists only within mirrors, I wander through a mansion with no exit. With every door I open, the landscape twists, until I finally arrive at a desert of despair where the remnants of memories fall like accumulating sand. The only oasis I find there offers a sweet temptation—and a cruel, devastating truth.

zh.title: 逆转秒针刻下的沙之棺
zh.premise: 遵循着仅存在于镜中的“秘密地图”，我在一座没有出口的宅邸中徘徊。每当我打开一扇门，景象便会发生扭曲，最终抵达的，竟是一片记忆残渣化作流沙、层层堆积的绝望沙漠。在那里，我发现的唯一绿洲在向我发出甜美诱惑的同时，也向我揭示了残酷的真相。
